added_failures_note: Derived from the completed baseline_suite and after_suite logs named by the reviewed manifest; this zero is scoped to those canonical arms, not the wider importer comparison.

assertion_analysis.fails_if: Scheduler output is absent, or task execution never reaches TASK_JOB; prevents a failed launch masquerading as a protected overwrite.
Absolute-path control is fenced, cannot execute, or fails to replace the decoy with the independently fixed replacement string.
Removing task re-entry lets the redirect succeed, removes the read-only refusal, or changes size/mtime/digest sampled before and after; recorded mutation reddens all four cases.
Removing the bootstrap fence allows the decoy overwrite or suppresses its read-only refusal.
Bootstrap loses stdin, changes caller PYTHONHOME, denies the fresh run log, or omits the supplied scratch root from the transported directories.
Scheduler option tokens change or option-value boundaries consume resources; these compare returned tokens to input because preservation is the contract, and do not independently prove protection.
Transport drops or changes the composed recipe; equality against the supplied recipe tests serialization fidelity only, not correctness of that recipe, which the independent target checks establish.
Parser wraps the wrong command or loses wrap-shell semantics; independent expected command literals provide the oracle.
Removing unknown-option, hook, heterogeneous-launch, conflicting-wrap or missing-value refusal lets that input return normally.

findings.text: blocking: exporting RECKON_WORKER_FENCE does not ensure PATH scheduler interception for all fenced launches: reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:776-777 adds scheduler shims only when placement.in_allocation is true, so a fenced worker launched outside SLURM with an ordinary scheduler PATH submits a task through the real sbatch/srun without re-entry; include fenced launches in shim provisioning and test the production launch_search_path path with in_allocation false.

importer_caveat.disposition: Outside this reviewer scope; reviewed brief delegates importer repairs/adjudication to the coordinator; canonical added_failure_count remains zero.
